claim: For the relativistic Euler equations with a complete equation of state, given initial data sufficiently close to a constant state in a Sobolev space, there exists a unique classical solution locally in time, and the existence time is independent of the speed of light c.
falsifier: One can numerically solve the relativistic Euler equations with various initial data and verify that a classical solution exists locally and the existence time does not depend on c.

conditions: initial data V0 ∈ V + H^{N0}(R^3) with V0 ∈ V1 ⊂⊂ V
exclusions: limited to the relativistic Euler equations with a complete equation of state and initial data in a Sobolev space of sufficiently high regularity

title: Relativistic Euler equations–local existence and uniqueness theorem
